_doc: The train lab's test line (issue #543, made data in step 2, #551): 1.5 km south then east of town on the flat. Plan: a straight, a 90 degree left-hand bend of 120 m radius eased in and out by 30 m spirals, then straight to the end (the last straight runs to `length`). Profile: grades in per cent from each distance on, each change eased over `vertical_curve` m. Marks are named points along the line (m from its start): the stops (depot, mine) and the grade posts. Everything on the line hangs off these names, never off world positions.
name: test_line
